messages:
nina: Heads-up — observability alerted on a churny routing pattern for a handful of EMEA customers. p95 went from 120ms -> 980ms over ~10m and we see repeated model variant swaps on the same requests (variant bounce).
raj: saw that too. traces show requests hit eu-north, then routed to eu-west, then us-west within the same session. weird TTL mismatch on the cache keys?
sarah: do we have a recent change to the region pref policy or the tier routing weights? I didn't touch routing but I pushed a fallback tweak yesterday.
oliver: we pushed an improvement to auto-fallback ordering to prefer cheaper variants; might be exposing incompatibility with the new region-prioritizer.
marta: attaching a short slice from the router logs — repeated 502 -> variant_fallback -> route_reassign loops
obs-bot: alert: routing.anomaly.high_cardinality (rate: 42/min) | tags: region:eu, symptom: variant-bounce
nina: here's an extract of the policy that might be involved:

```
route_policy:
  - match: region:eu
    prefer: [variant-v1, variant-v2]
    fallback_order: [variant-v2, variant-v1, variant-legacy]
    region_pin: false
  - match: tier:enterprise
    prefer_region: customer_region
```
raj: note the region_pin:false — that allows routing to reassign when capacity is low. if fallback_order is cycling between v1 and v2 and region changes, you can get a cascade.
sarah: can we temporary-enforce region pin for eu? i.e. set region_pin: true for eu routes until we root-cause.
oliver: agreed. quick mitigation: enable strict region pinning for any request with session_id header present. small config flip with our internal flag rollbackable in 30s.
marta: I can flip the flag. curl below to toggle feature flag (internal
auth):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/flags/routing.region_pin" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \ 
  -d '{"value": true, "scope": "eu"}'
```
nina: deploy-bot — can you coordinate a short runbook for engineering on-call? would like to ask SRE to hold capacity static for 15m after the flip.
deploy-bot: scheduled: flag toggle in 45s (user: marta). Canary: eu-north only -> 1% -> 100% on success. Rollback on error.
raj: while the canary runs, let's add a circuit-breaker on the fallback path so we don't allow more than 3 successive fallbacks per session. pseudo-config:
```
fallback_circuit:
  max_consecutive: 3
  cooldown_seconds: 120
```
sarah: also adding a short-lived dashboard (metric: routing.variant_swap_rate by customer_id) to detect noisy customers. obs team, can you surface top 10 customers driving the churn?
obs-bot: added dashboard link: https://obs.redwood/dashboards/rt-variant-bounce-1830123456
marta: canary completed 1% -> 100% in 90s. no errors. region_pin=true applied for scope=eu.
oliver: already seeing swap rate drop in the dashboard, p95 trending down. nice.
raj: we should still patch the root cause — looks like a mismatch in variant compatibility headers that made the router think variants were incompatible, forcing fallback. I'll open a quick PR to add stronger variant-compat checks and tighten the fallback ordering algorithm.
nina: and UX action — console should show a small icon on rollout pages when region_pin:false is in effect and warn about variant bounce risk. product please follow up.
sarah: created FE ticket: RLW-872 show routing pin warning + link to explain mitigation. assigned to @marta for copy.
marta: follow-up: I also throttled variant_legacy fallback to 10rps per-customer as a safety-net. command run.
nina: good job team. let's keep monitoring for 2 hours and keep this thread updated. if the circuit breaker trips, escalate to infra oncall.
oliver: FYI — I captured a minimal repro (curl with session header) and put it in the repo under /eng-platform/variant-repro. will link in next msg.
raj: PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4567 — adds stricter compat and the fallback circuit. please review.
sarah: rx, reviewing now. :thumbsup:
marta: one more note — we should add telemetry tag "fallback_reason" to trace spans (capacity, incompat, timeout) so next time we can filter quickly.
obs-bot: note: new metric requested: routing.fallback_reason_count (pending)
nina: closing loop — p95 back to ~130ms, variant swap rate down 92% vs peak. leaving region_pin true for 30m then we will test a controlled rollback.
raj: will follow up on the PR and postmortem blurb. thanks all.
